text:
Type: square low table on casters
Use: holding drinks, magazines and remotes in front of or beside a sofa; living room, family room, kids room
Style: minimalist, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: white laminated board, chrome-look casters
Colors: white, silver
Shape: square top with rounded edges, open lower shelf, four thick block legs on small round wheels, low and wide, light visual weight
Feel: clean, bright, practical, easygoing
Goes with: white or grey sofas, light wood floors, simple accents; Scandinavian or modern living rooms and small apartments

product.name: TINGBY
product.description: Separate shelf for magazines, etc. helps you keep your things organised and the table top clear.
